strengths.text: You stated the 14-day refund and the 6-kid batch structure accurately and early.
Your discount arithmetic was correct and within the cap.

fixes.text: When a young child was overwhelmed, the policy gives you a better answer than the standard batch. Use it.
fixes.better_line: You're right, Swathi ma'am. The group was too fast for Ananya. Coach Arvind recommended a gentler option. We can offer a complimentary 1-on-1 bridge session, and I'll ask our academic team about a beginners' group for her age today.

fixes.text: Questions are for listening. One question, then reflect the parent's answer before the next.
fixes.better_line: How did Ananya feel at the end of the class?

coaching.next_call_drill: Ask one open question, wait, then say back one thing the parent told you before moving on.
